issues.title: Avatar group stacking order not mirrored
issues.description: AvatarGroup elements overlap using LTR order instead of RTL.
issues.evidence: Avatar group in top header displays '+6' count on the far left overlapping adjacent avatars.
issues.suggestion: Mirror negative margins and stacking index for RTL direction.
issues.triageNote: Verified false positive: Tailwind v4 -space-x-2 compiles to logical margin-inline-end on :not(:last-child), so the negative margins DO mirror in RTL. Playwright probe on live /eval/pair-004 (dark/RTL): every adjacent pair overlaps exactly 8px and the later-DOM element paints on top — the exact mirror of LTR; the '+6' count sitting far left is the correct mirrored position (far right in LTR). VLM inspection of the cropped header confirms uniform, correctly-mirrored stacking. No code change needed.

issues.title: Low contrast avatar fallbacks
issues.description: Avatar fallback text lacks sufficient contrast against circular backgrounds in dark mode.
issues.evidence: Initials MA, JD, SC and +5 badge use dark gray text on near-black fills.
issues.suggestion: Increase font color brightness token for dark theme avatars.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: AvatarFallback/AvatarGroupCount used text-muted-foreground (dark: rgb 143 140 132) on bg-muted (dark: rgb 21 21 19) — pixel-confirmed in screenshot; soft/illegible at text-sm in size-8 circles. Fixed in src/components/ui/avatar.tsx: dark:text-neutral-600 (rgb 168 164 155, ~7.3:1) on both, plus dark:after:border-neutral-300 on the Avatar ring (was a ~20-level whisper hairline in dark). Verified by re-audit: ui:avatar issue gone.
